node.title: Re^3: String differs from printing to STDOUT and printing to file
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Thanks for posting the code, it confirms [GrandFather]'s suggestion; using my advice from [id://11107885|here] to use [doc://Devel::Peek] to inspect $dec, it shows:

SV = PV(0x571d5fd57c40) at 0x560d5ed7d9a0 REFCNT = 1 FLAGS = (POK,IsCOW,pPOK) PV = 0x571d5fe15180 "QeTEv2804\0\0\0\0\0\0\0"\0 CUR = 16 LEN = 18 COW_REFCNT = 0

As per the [mod://Crypt::Rijndael] docs, the blocksize for Rijndael is 16 bytes.
